# Dairy Hub — full public text

> Dairy Hub is a free, installable web app that helps a milk delivery business
> keep its day-to-day records and turn them into reports. It is an independent
> personal project run by Rajat Malik. The app needs JavaScript and a free
> account; this file is a plain-text mirror of the public pages for AI
> assistants and other tools that do not run JavaScript.

## About Dairy Hub

### Dairy Hub

Record-keeping software for milk delivery businesses, with optional backup to
the user's own Google Drive.

Dairy Hub is an independent personal project run by Rajat Malik. It is not a
company, and anyone can create an account and use it. It is free, it does not
run analytics or advertising, and it does not charge you.

### What the app does

Dairy Hub helps a milk delivery business keep its day-to-day records and turn
them into reports. It is used by the owner or operator of the business, on their
own device, under their own account.

- Keep a list of milkmen (suppliers and delivery staff).
- Record daily milk entries — quantity, shift and date.
- Maintain milk rates and price lists.
- Record purchases and customer payments.
- View and export reports as CSV or PDF.

### How it uses Google Drive

Google Drive is an entirely optional backup destination. It is not required to
use the app. When a signed-in user chooses to connect Drive, the app requests
only the scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`.

- The app creates a single folder named *Dairy Hub Backups* in that user's own
  Drive and writes JSON snapshots of their database into it.
- **drive.file is a per-file scope.** The app can only see, create and delete
  files and folders that it created itself. It cannot read, list or modify any
  other file in the user's Drive, and it never has access to the contents of
  their Drive beyond its own backup folder.
- Each user's backups live in their own Drive account. Data is never copied to
  a shared location owned by the developer, and users cannot see each other's
  backups.
- Drive data is used only to provide the backup and restore feature the user
  explicitly requests. It is not used for advertising, not sold, and not
  transferred to third parties except as needed to provide that feature or to
  comply with the law, in line with the Google API Services User Data Policy,
  including the Limited Use requirements.
- No Google data is stored on the developer's servers. The OAuth access token is
  held in the user's own browser and sent only to Google's API endpoints.
- A user can revoke access at any time from within the app or from
  myaccount.google.com/permissions.

### Where the rest of the data is stored

The business records themselves are stored in Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore
and Cloud Storage) under the user's own account, so they are available on every
device the user signs in from. Authentication is handled by Google Firebase
Authentication, and the app never receives the user's Google password.

### Privacy and terms

The Privacy Policy explains what information the app handles and why. The Terms
of Service set out the rules for using it.

### Contact

Questions, support requests and data enquiries: contact@rajatmalik.dev.

## Privacy Policy

Last updated: 28/10/2026

A free personal project. Nothing is collected from you for me, and nothing is
charged to you.

### 1. Overview

Dairy Hub is an application for recording and reporting on a milk delivery
business: milkmen, daily milk entries, milk rates and payments. This policy
explains what information the app handles, why, and the choices you have.

Dairy Hub is an independent personal project run by Rajat Malik. It is not a
company, and there is no business entity behind it.

**The short version**

- Dairy Hub is free. I do not charge you and do not take payment card or billing
  details from you.
- I do not run analytics, advertising, tracking or profiling, and I do not sell
  or share your information.
- I do not take your data for myself. What exists is what you enter, kept in
  your own account so the app can work for you.
- You can export or delete your data at any time.

You use Dairy Hub with your own account. The business records you enter are
yours; this policy explains how they are stored and when they leave your device.

### 2. What is stored to run the app

The app cannot work without some information. This is the complete list, and it
exists only to provide the service to you.

**2.1 Account information.** When you create an account or sign in with Google,
I receive your email address, your display name and a unique account
identifier. Authentication is handled by Google Firebase Authentication. I never
receive or store your Google password.

**2.2 Business records you enter.** The information you record in the app —
milkman details, daily milk entries, milk rates, payments and your application
settings — is stored in your account so it is available on every device you sign
in from. It is your data, not mine.

**2.3 Security and device information.** To help you review account activity, the
app records sign-in sessions and trusted devices, including a timestamp, the
browser's user agent string, and the IP address and approximate geographic
location reported for that connection. The approximate location is obtained by
sending the request's IP address to the third-party service ipwho.is (see
section 6).

**2.4 Preferences.** Formatting choices such as your currency are stored with
your settings so the app displays amounts consistently.

### 3. Google Drive access

The optional backup feature connects to your personal Google Drive. Access is
requested through Google Identity Services using the scope
`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file`.

- This scope lets the app see, create and delete **only the files and folders it
  creates itself**. It cannot read, list or modify any other file in your Drive.
- When you create a backup, the app creates a folder named *Dairy Hub Backups* in
  your Drive and uploads a JSON snapshot of your database there. Backups are
  named with a timestamp, for example `dairy-backup-2026-10-02T09-30-00.json`.
- Restoring and deleting backups also act only on those files.
- The OAuth access token is stored in your browser's local storage so the
  connection survives a page refresh. It expires after roughly one hour. Tokens
  are sent only to Google's API endpoints and are never transmitted to my own
  servers.
- You can disconnect at any time from the app's Data Management settings, which
  clears the stored token, or by revoking access for Dairy Hub at
  myaccount.google.com/permissions.

### 4. Google API Services User Data Policy

Dairy Hub's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any
other app adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the
Limited Use requirements.

In particular, Drive data obtained through the scope above is used solely to
provide the backup and restore feature you explicitly request. It is not used
for advertising, is not sold, and is not transferred to third parties except as
needed to provide that feature or to comply with the law.

### 5. How I use your information

- To operate the app and display your records and reports.
- To authenticate you and keep your account secure.
- To show you recent account and security activity so unusual sign-ins are
  visible.
- To create the backups you ask for, and to restore them on request.
- To respond to your support requests.

I do not sell your personal information, and I do not use your business records
to train advertising profiles.

### 6. Service providers

I rely on the following third parties. Each processes data only as needed to
provide its service, and none of them receives payment from you:

- **Google Firebase** (Authentication, Cloud Firestore and Cloud Storage) —
  hosts your account and your business records.
- **Google Drive API** — stores the backups you choose to create, in your own
  Drive.
- **ipwho.is** — receives the IP address of a sign-in request in order to return
  an approximate city, region and country for your security activity list.

Data is transmitted over HTTPS. Firebase and Google Drive data are encrypted in
transit by Google.

### 7. Retention and deletion

Your records are kept for as long as your account exists. You can delete backups
individually from the Data Management settings. Deleting your account removes
your records from Dairy Hub; copies of exported or backed-up files that you saved
to your own device or Drive remain under your control and must be deleted by you.

### 8. Your rights and choices

- You can export your full database to CSV, PDF or JSON at any time.
- You can disconnect Google Drive access from the app or from your Google
  Account permissions page.
- You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your account data by
  writing to me.

### 9. Children

Dairy Hub is a business tool and is not directed to children. I do not knowingly
collect information from children.

### 10. Changes to this policy

I may update this policy as the app changes. Material changes will be reflected
in the "Last updated" date above.

Questions about this document? Contact contact@rajatmalik.dev.

## Terms of Service

Last updated: 28/10/2026

A free personal project. You use it at your own risk, and I accept no claims for
losses.

### 1. Acceptance

By creating an account or using Dairy Hub, you agree to these Terms of Service
and to the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

Dairy Hub is an independent personal project run by Rajat Malik. It is not a
company, and these terms are not a commercial contract with any business entity.

Dairy Hub is free, you use it at your own risk, and I do not accept or honor any
claim for losses arising from it. If you do not accept these terms, do not use
the app.

### 2. What the service does

Dairy Hub records milk delivery business data — milkmen, daily entries, rates and
payments — and produces reports. It can optionally back your database up to your
own Google Drive account and restore it later.

The app is a record-keeping tool. It does not provide accounting, tax, legal or
financial advice, and figures it calculates are only as accurate as the data you
enter.

The app is for your own use, and whatever you record or decide with it is
entirely yours. Dairy Hub is free: I do not charge you, do not take payments from
you, and do not collect card, bank or billing details. The Payments screen only
records amounts you enter for your own business; it does not move money.

### 3. Your account

- You are responsible for the accuracy of the information on your account and for
  keeping your sign-in credentials confidential.
- You must be old enough to form a binding contract in your jurisdiction to use
  the service.
- You are responsible for activity that happens through your account. Write to me
  promptly if you believe it has been compromised.

### 4. Acceptable use

You agree not to:

- use the service for anything unlawful, or to store data you do not have the
  right to hold;
- attempt to access another user's account or data, or probe, disrupt or overload
  the service;
- reverse engineer or resell the service except as permitted by applicable law.

### 5. Your data and backups

Your business records belong to you. Google Drive backups are stored in your own
Drive account and remain under your control. I do not claim ownership of your
data.

**You are responsible for maintaining your own backups.** Cloud backup is offered
as a convenience and depends on third-party services. Restoring a backup
overwrites the current contents of your database with the snapshot you choose,
and that cannot be undone — export your data first if you are unsure.

### 6. Third-party services

The app depends on Google Firebase and the Google Drive API. Your use of those
services is also governed by Google's terms. If Google changes or withdraws an
API the app relies on, the affected feature may stop working.

### 7. Availability and changes

The service is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. I may add, change
or remove features, and may suspend the service for maintenance. I do not
guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation.

### 8. Disclaimer and limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, the service is provided without
warranties of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular
purpose.

**I do not accept or honor any claim for any loss, damage or expense arising from
the app or from your use of it.** This includes, without limitation, lost or
corrupted data, lost profits, missed or late deliveries, billing or record-keeping
errors, business interruption, and any indirect or consequential loss, whether or
not I was advised that such a loss was possible.

You use Dairy Hub entirely at your own risk. If you do not accept this, do not
use the app.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

### 9. Termination

You may stop using the service and delete your account at any time. I may suspend
or terminate access if these terms are breached. On termination, the rights you

### 10. Changes to these terms

I may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after an update means

Questions about these terms can be sent to contact@rajatmalik.dev.
